main_text.l: In hac expeditione Scythæ Bactrianis & Parthis originem dederunt: quippe Scytharum pars reliqua in Persia & Media tandem in Parthorum & Bactrianorum prævalidas nationes excreverunt.
India in plura regna distracta fuit.

Indorum Imperium conditum traditur a Baccho, quicunq; tandem is fuerit; post quem 153. ordine reges regnasse tradunt, quorum nec quidem nomina nota sunt. Mentio unius tantum fit Regis Stawrobatos [?], qui bellum contra Semiramidem gessisse dicitur. India igitur incogni-

page.notes: The left margin notes are small and partly cut off at the left edge: "Bactria-" is read as "Bastria-" with the long s, and "deuc-runt" is uncertain (possibly "dederunt"). The word "Stawrobatos" is marked [?] because its letters are hard to read. "Indorum Imperium conditum" is copied as it appears. The text ends at "incogni-", which continues on the next page.
